prompt: GraphQL FieldSelectionMap SelectedListValue elements allowed difference ListValue
answer:
`SelectedListValue` differs from GraphQL’s `ListValue` in these ways:

| Feature | `SelectedListValue` | GraphQL `ListValue` |
|---|---|---|
| Element syntax | `[ SelectedValue ]` or `[ SelectedListValue ]` | `[ ]` or `[ Value+ ]` |
| Elements per list item | Allows only **one `SelectedValue`** as an element | Allows **one or more `Value`** elements |
| Nested lists | Supports nested `SelectedListValue` | Supports list values generally |
| Purpose | Expresses semantic equivalence between an input list argument and a list field in the output object | Represents an ordinary GraphQL input list |
| Example implication | A list selection such as `[id]` is valid; multiple selected values as list elements are invalid | Values such as `[1, 2, 3]` are valid |

Thus, the key difference is that `SelectedListValue` restricts each list element to a single `SelectedValue`, whereas `ListValue` permits multiple arbitrary GraphQL values. [[Field Selection specification](https://github.com/graphql/graphql-federation-spec/blob/main/spec/Appendix%20A%20--%20Field%20Selection.md)] [[GraphQL Language specification](https://github.com/graphql/graphql-spec/blob/main/spec/Section%202%20--%20Language.md)]
